16 Osaka hotels, each priced on every booking site we recorded for it. Prices on this page are per night, all-in where the sites reported taxes and fees; the study's count below uses the before-tax prices of its CSV. The going rate is the price the largest number of listings that named a room or offered free cancellation agreed on (ties go to the lower price).

One snapshot on September 28, 2026 for Nov 2 to Nov 4, 2 adults, US market, USD. Prices change daily.

Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Osaka hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 28, 2026 snapshot, at 15 of the 17 Osaka hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: klook at 4, Agoda at 3, Priceline at 3, Ikyu.com at 2, Hoteis.com at 1, skyticket at 1 and Trip.com at 1. These are the Osaka rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

On this page, all-in: with taxes and fees as the sites reported them (a resort or destination fee may be extra), at 14 of the 16 hotels listed below a site was 5% or more below the all-in going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: klook at 4, Bluepillow.com at 3, Ikyu.com at 3, Agoda at 2, Etrip.net at 1, goseek.com at 1, Hoteis.com at 1, KAYAK.com at 1 and 8 other sites at 8 between them (a tie counts for each site). At the other 2, no site was 5% or more below it. The two counts differ: at 1 of the hotels listed below, the all-in prices put the gap on the other side of the 5% line, and the study also counts the 1 named below that are not listed on this page. Taxes and fees at Osaka hotels

At the 12 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 11% ($4 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 7% at Bande Hotel in Namba to 22% at Hotel Meldia Osaka Higobashi. At 4 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
